## F — Structured research index

Open verification debts for this section: none. Every sign colors and shapes, regulatory signs such as stop, yield, speed limit, lane use, do not pass, no passing zone, pass with care, alignment and exclusion signs, warning signs, guide and information signs, and construction and maintenance devices including channelizing devices, arrow panels and flagpersons claim in parts C and C-two carries a page-bound anchor, and part D raised no accuracy flag.

Exam facts recorded as unknown (question count, passing standard, time limit, format) are terminal unknown states from part A, not open debts; they need no VERIFY entry.

Market and teardown scope statements live in parts E and E-two; audience and exam-authority context live in parts B and A.

Consolidated VERIFY list: empty for this section. No source-form caution applies; the sign pictures are illustrative and every rule is printed as text.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the sign colors and shapes, regulatory signs such as stop, yield, speed limit, lane use, do not pass, no passing zone, pass with care, alignment and exclusion signs, warning signs, guide and information signs, and construction and maintenance devices including channelizing devices, arrow panels and flagpersons rules on pages 43–51 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
